config.description: Owner-confirmed butanol sample: compare C-D/O-D susceptibility with the existing single-site fit on the same five raw scans.
config.theory: Supplied fit_multisite.py: weak-quadrupole two-site option, common P and physical Lorentzian HWHM, distinct EFG asymmetries and splittings; 1/split relative site normalization.
config.electronics: Unchanged full-circuit topology and shared parameter bounds from experimental-matching.json. No additional voltage polynomial, frequency rescaling or empirical gain tilt.
config.amplitude_convention: log10_signal_scale_cgs retains the existing C-D peak-scale convention; multiply by split_cd_mhz to obtain the integrated susceptibility scale in cgs*MHz.

od_split_ratio.source: Ordering the O-D scale above C-D fixes site identity; initial ratio 1.45/0.92 from supplied demonstration, numerical bounds are not measured material constants.

eta_od.source: Supplied demonstration seed; fitted O-D EFG asymmetry, numerical search interval.

od_fraction.source: Supplied demonstration seed and interval; effective O-D susceptibility weight, not independently measured chemical fraction.

limitations: Shared spin temperature and common site linewidth are hypotheses
Weak-quadrupole intensity option; frequency-dependent population corrections are not included
Three extra fitted coordinates can reduce training residuals; validate material identification and polarization independently

acquisition.frequency_source: Repository owner: every baseline is timestamp plus 500 bins; retain the original proton sweep's bin offsets and spacing, replacing its nominal 213 MHz center with 32.7 MHz.
acquisition.derivation: f_j = (212.6 + 0.0015287*j) - (213 - 32.7) = 32.3 + 0.0015287*j MHz, j=0..499. The last sample is 33.0628213 MHz; 32.7 MHz is the nominal center, not the endpoint midpoint.

signal_parsing.timestamp_order: not strictly increasing; input order retained
signal_parsing.policy: Preserve every record and all 500 values; audit U+2028 and blank separators; no smoothing, rescaling or deduplication
signal_parsing.frequency_grid: Not stored in CSV; supplied separately as an acquisition contract

single_site_matching_config.description: Match the five experimental spin-1 sweeps and infer polarization from the complex lineshape. No TE calibration is required. These five scans are development examples, not a held-out performance benchmark.
single_site_matching_config.grid_source: Experimental set up details: signal scans use the same 500-bin frequency grid and n=1, 358.0 cm cable setup as the baseline example.
single_site_matching_config.hardware_hypothesis: Use the stated n=1 half-wave at nominal length 3.580 m, nominal coil and resistances, and zero shunt stray capacitance as an explicit first-model assumption. FIT the tuning capacitance and slow detector phase as in paper Eqs. 10-14. Other fixed component seeds remain assumptions, not new measurements. Do not inherit the previous bound-saturated baseline solution as known hardware.
single_site_matching_config.spin_hypothesis: Single-site deuteron Pake powder, complex absorption and dispersion, spin-temperature Q(P). No independent tensor enhancement assumed.

center_mhz.source: Initial position estimated from localized features; numerical search range on the confirmed acquisition grid.

split_mhz.source: Half-separation scale in the reduced-frequency Pake model; initial feature spacing, not a quadrupole calibration.

g.source: Lorentzian HWHM divided by splitting scale; numerical model-development interval.

eta.source: Single-site EFG asymmetry hypothesis; numerical interval, not measured material composition.

P_model.source: Polarization inferred by fitting the spin-temperature Pake branch shapes and their integrated intensity ratio; no TE calibration required.

log10_signal_scale_cgs.source: Log10 effective susceptibility amplitude with filling factor held nominal; not independent material calibration.

phase_slope_rad_per_mhz.source: Unknown slow detector-phase slope; explicit sensitivity bounds, not measured phase uncertainty.

phase_curvature_rad_per_mhz2.source: Unknown slow detector-phase curvature from paper Eq. 10; explicit numerical bounds, not a voltage polynomial.

log10_tune_capacitance_pf.source: Unknown tuning capacitor, fitted with an initial 50 pF scale close to the earlier fit. Search interval 10-2000 pF is numerical, not a measured tolerance.

diagnostics.sigma_proxy_assumption: MAD(second differences)/(0.67449 sqrt(6)); iid Gaussian noise and locally smooth mean. Not a validated noise covariance.

fits.P_status: Common site spin-temperature lineshape estimate; no TE prerequisite; not independent truth
fits.material_status: Owner-confirmed butanol; fitted O-D weight is an effective signal fraction, not a measured chemical abundance

theory_source.adopted: Two-site C-D/O-D sum, common polarization and physical Lorentzian width, separate splitting and EFG asymmetry, inverse-splitting relative normalization; weak-quadrupole intensity option
theory_source.adaptation: Existing normalized complex orientation integral and Gauss-Legendre azimuth average; full physical circuit retained. No dependence on the source directory at runtime.
theory_source.not_adopted: Synthetic example units/values as measurements, endpoint-inclusive uniform phi mean, empirical gain tilt, free frequency-axis rescaling, or cubic voltage baseline in the full-circuit butanol comparison.
